spans.s: प्र-√ तृद् (only ind.p. -तृद्य), to thrust through with a spit, ŚBr.
प्र-˚तृद् mfn. cleaving, piercing (applied to the Tṛtsus), RV. vii, 33, 14.
प्र-˚तृण्ण n. (piercing i.e. splitting scil. the words) recitation of the Pada-pāṭha, AitĀr.
प्र-√ तृप् Caus. -तर्पयति, to satiate, refresh, strengthen, satisfy, Pañcat.; Suśr.
प्रा—तृद॑ m. patr. fr. प्रतृद्, ŚBr. (Sāy.)
